record.question: Tourist ILP for a period not exceeding ___________may be issued for tourism purpose which is not extendable after expiry of the validity as per The Mizoram Inner Line Pass Guidelines 2026.
record.explanation: The printed question on page 6 matches the packet. Vanglaini’s 4 September 2026 report quotes the Hnahthial Deputy Commissioner explaining that the 2026 guidelines provide a Tourist ILP valid for 30 days, without renewal (https://www.vanglaini.org/tualchhung/175265). This supports thirty days; confidence is medium because the underlying government guidelines could not be retrieved directly.
